eligibility_contract.nontrivial_maneuver: cumulative absolute heading change >= 0.35 rad or source speed range >= 1.0 m/s
required_records: accepted source and replay semantic metric records

feature_definitions.annotation_density_score: source semantic event count / max(path length in metres, 1)
feature_definitions.cumulative_absolute_heading_change_rad: sum of wrapped absolute changes between displacement headings for source steps of at least 0.10 m
feature_definitions.path_length_m: sum of consecutive valid-source XY distances
feature_definitions.semantic_preservation_f1: 2 * matched source/replay events / (source events + replay events)
feature_definitions.spatial_extent: axis ranges and XY bounding-box diagonal

readability_gate.recommendation_policy: recommend the first ranked top-three candidate passing every gate

tie_break_rules.numeric_equality: continue to the next declared ranking key
